qualification: Uncommitted public-wrapper prototype only. Exact-source, package and hosted qualification are separate.

inputManifest.provenance: Synthetic OOXML independently authored with the MIT fixture helper; no wordnet serialization.

independentTools: Open XML SDK 3.5.1; Python jsonschema and rfc8785 0.1.4; Poppler 24.02.0 in the pinned reference container; fixed field clock 2026-11-01T12:00:00Z.

result.limitations: Prototype public wrapper covers only single-run alphanumeric DOCX to strict PDF without loss or template data; live independent validation is not performed.

independentCheck.controlMethod: Independent observations were altered in memory.

limitations: Five schema-valid single-run alphanumeric DOCX inputs were accepted. Stale input, stale policy, unmatched permission and unknown semantic rejected without touching output. This profile does not admit template data or allowed losses, independently validate output during execution, or demonstrate a real unexpected write-stage finding. Strict loss exceptions are classified as conversion failures.
